steps.action: Register provider against the local OpenID Connect fixture; copy the callback URL; registration turns on nothing
steps.expected: Saved; callback ends /api/auth/sso/callback on the instance address; SSO switches stay off; Provider ID fixed
steps.actual: Register provider showed Saved and "Paste this callback URL into your IdP console: http://127.0.0.1:23310/api/auth/sso/callback". Both Single sign-on (SSO) switches stayed off but became available (["false","false"]). After reload the Provider ID field was gone and the button read Save provider.

steps.actual: Check failed: {"path":"/auth/login","me":401,"role":null,"alert":[]} {"present":true,"status":"Active","roleControl":true,"role":"Legal team member","actions":["Legal team member","Sign out user","Archive"]}

steps.action: Recover: Administrator password sign-in with Email and password off under Legal, then turn on Email and password and turn off SSO
steps.expected: Admin password sign-in works; staff login returns to password; SSO off
steps.actual: With only Single sign-on (SSO) on for Legal users ({"password":false,"magicLink":false,"sso":true,"requireTwoFactor":false}), the Administrator still signed in with a password (me 200). Turning Email and password and Email magic link back on and SSO off in both cards gave {"legal":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false},"business":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}}, and the Legal Team Member signed in with a password again (me 200).
